embedded_recovery_document_learning.historical_topology_note: D1/D2 embed a 2026-09-02 historical 5-logical-set / 8-physical-file continuation protocol. It is provenance only and MUST NOT override the external/current SYNC-R74 5-Part / 9-Package Manifest, Trust Root, READ FIRST, or current Hub pointers.
embedded_recovery_document_learning.conflict_rule: If authority conflict is unresolved, stop as AUTHORITY_CONFLICT_UNRESOLVED rather than guessing.
embedded_recovery_document_learning.reseal_rule: Full CURRENT reseal requires SHA256 manifest, CRC, fresh extraction validation, and developer delivery manifest; primary evidence is never deleted/overwritten.
embedded_recovery_document_learning.db_rule: If DB semantic payload is unchanged, preserve byte identity where declared and record SEMANTIC_PAYLOAD_UNCHANGED/BYTE_UNCHANGED rather than mutating carriers merely because later research advanced.
embedded_recovery_document_learning.split_rule: Validate outer transport -> embedded chunk -> logical rejoin -> nested required packages as four distinct custody layers. One PASS never substitutes for the next.

container_resilience_learning: ClientError/TransportTimeout at a tool boundary is not scientific, engine, package, or DB failure without valid-byte reproduction.
On minimal-command failure: STOP -> RUNTIME_TRANSPORT_HOLD -> MINIMAL_HEALTH_CHECK -> LAST_ATOMIC_CHECKPOINT_VERIFY -> RESUME_ONLY_FAILED_STEP.
Use exact grounded sandbox paths only; relist/recheck before declaring missing due to mount readiness.
Visible file presence is not byte authority; verify size -> SHA256 -> ZIP central directory -> CRC -> required members.
For split data carriers, stream chunks into /tmp logical verifier in declared order, hash while streaming, verify logical ZIP, then delete temporary.
Use one large artifact at a time, streaming I/O and POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED; do not call OOM unless memory.events reports oom/oom_kill.
GeneratedFileUploadError is a delivery-boundary failure if local output completion and hashes are proven; do not recompute expensive work solely because attachment registration failed.
Same-name/different-hash authority objects must be preserved and quarantined; never overwrite or silently choose.
Nested historical CURRENT_* files cannot supersede current external manifest/trust-root/handoff.
Never reconstruct lost hidden mapping/frozen inputs from memory; HOLD or abort the affected experiment.
mutation_policy: No package mutation, reseal, physical promotion, runtime change, DB authority change, formal-count change, or experimental scoring was performed.
